Class WhoEnrollmentService

java.lang.Object
org.jwcarman.who.enrollment.WhoEnrollmentService
public class WhoEnrollmentService extends Object
Service for managing enrollment tokens that link credentials to identities.

The application is responsible for delivering the token value to the user (e.g. via email) and for creating the Credential before calling enroll(String, Credential). This service only handles the token lifecycle and the credential-to-identity link.

  • Method Details

    • createToken

      public EnrollmentToken createToken(Identity identity)
      Creates and persists a new enrollment token for the given identity.

      The caller is responsible for delivering token.value() to the user.

      Parameters:
      identity - the identity to enroll a credential for
      Returns:
      the newly created PENDING token
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if no identity with the given id exists

    • enroll

      @Transactional public Identity enroll(String tokenValue, Credential credential)
      Redeems an enrollment token, linking the credential to the identity.

      The token must be PENDING and not expired, and its identity ACTIVE. The token is redeemed with a single conditional update, so concurrent attempts cannot both succeed; the credential is then linked to the identity in the same transaction.

      Parameters:
      tokenValue - the shareable token value given to the user
      credential - the credential to link
      Returns:
      the identity the credential was linked to
      Throws:
      EnrollmentTokenNotFoundException - if no token with the given value exists
      EnrollmentTokenExpiredException - if the token has passed its expiration time
      EnrollmentTokenNotPendingException - if the token is already redeemed or revoked
      EnrollmentIdentityInactiveException - if the token's identity is not active
      CredentialAlreadyLinkedException - if the credential is already linked to an identity

      @Transactional public void revokeToken(EnrollmentToken token)
